posts.text:
If you're not taking action right now because you think we're about to get the big beautiful obituary, then you're doing exactly what this administration wants us to do — give up.

So keep wishing for that day *and* keep fighting because this horror still won't be fully over when that man dies.
Read more in this fantastic analysis from @carbonbrief.org:
ICYMI: Clean energy projects have helped the United Kingdom save £1.7 billion and counting in fossil fuel imports since the beginning of the war with Iran.

I think I figured out why my city is attempting to attract data centers — they are short the funds needed to pay out a $30 million settlement fund to victims because the police covered up the sexual assault, pedophilia, and drug crimes of a good ol’ boy.

Do you know how I know that genAI isn't as good as tech companies would like us to believe?

Every single day I receive emails from AI agents representing the solid waste industry who want to aquire my company because they think it's a waste disposal service instead of a climate media business!

Wait, y’all are surprised I’m siding with a drag queen climate activist over a corporation that has repeatedly refused to work with me and so many others on environmental storytelling initiatives??

Copyright law be damned. Of course I’m supporting Pattie Gonia!!

This is my local police department. They’re ALL corrupt. 

I used to work in local/state government here and know way more than is publicly available. That’s why I know I can’t trust the cops.

The newest fossil fuel disinformation talking point just dropped — the industry is trying to convince us that plug-in solar panels backfeed onto the grid during outages and will kill electricians.

That’s unequivocally false! They’re specifically designed to prevent backfeeding onto the grid.
Because I’m progressive and they’re conservative. That’s pretty much what it boils down to..

Right?! I’m fully expecting the FBI to show up my house because I’ve been labeled as a domestic terrorist for my climate and anti-AI activism. Why would I report intimidation to them?? They support it!!

This has unfortunately been my life for the past 2 years. I get followed, yelled at, and threatened both in front of my house and when I’m out in public. It doesn’t matter if I’m talking about climate, Trump, or data centers. MAGA hates my guts!

Thank you for all the kind words and support! I get intimidated by my own community pretty much every time a video I produce as a climate activist gains traction online, so I’m unfortunately used to it — and have many security measures in place. I am Appalachian after all 😉
You clearly underestimate the pettiness of Appalachians.
I’m pretty sure they just hate me because I’m a progressive climate scientist 🫠
Oh, I’m well aware. If my husband is with me, these things never happen, but the second I’m alone folks get weird!!
I’ve thankfully already got fans and sound machines running at night. MAGA youth love to hang out a few blocks away and drag race when I’m trying to sleep.
Check your privilege. I don’t have access to alternatives nor could I afford them even if they existed in my area. That’s the case for quite a few Americans outside of cities.
I refuse to let these idiots drive me out of my hometown!
Already got several🫡

I don’t trust the local cops one bit. They’ve refused to investigate past instances of intimidation — including when someone threatened me in line at Kroger while openly carrying a gun. 

Plus, this article is about them.
Please don’t fall for the lies being spread right now about #pluginsolar!
Don’t want data centers in your community? Make plans to vote in the elections this November *only* for candidates who don’t want data centers.

⚠️ Johnson City, TN ⚠️ Fill out the data center regulation survey at the link in bio and below then make plans to vote in the upcoming elections in August and November for candidates who don’t support data centers. https://cojctn.wufoo.com/forms/q14lbsgz13tezj8/?utm_source=ig&utm_medium=social&utm_content=link_in_bio&fbclid=PAdGRleAR-qXZleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA8xMjQwMjQ1NzQyODc0MTQAAacMn8ZoGvD-7G6suBDI2aBVmoYoB7ITAScnDS29B3_Pm0NJWauHR7ajHVkjRg_aem_aOxG5IVhJObN9tDP__LXbg #johnsoncitytn #jo
All hope is not lost when it comes to protecting our planet!!  Art Credit: @kat  Go check out her work! I have one of her paintings and her oracle deck :)
Paris is proving that cities can quickly reverse their car dependency!
I thought we could all use a little pep talk because the doomscroll keeps getting worse 😮‍💨😅
Plug-in solar has been rapidly growing across the globe in recent years, so it makes sense it’s finally coming to the United States!
Tomorrow I turn 30. Do you think I’ll finally stop getting called a youth climate activist?
Reversing deforestation is absolutely possible. Just ask Costa Rica 🇨🇷
GOOD NEWS: 59 countries have agreed to develop national roadmaps for phasing out fossil fuels after attending the first ever conference aimed at phasing out fossil fuels in Santa Marta, Colombia.
